Title: Architecture review gate A
Purpose: Stop after the baseline, canonical dependency, and validation-purity work, then perform a strict architectural review before any transaction or persistence refactor begins.
Deliverables: Explicit pass/fail decision for the canonical foundation.
A corrective subbundle if the gate fails.
ValidationCommands: Review execution-report rows and the proof generated by subbundles 01-03.
Confirm the canonical dependency model and pure-validation proof are explicit and sufficient.
ReviewQuestions: Is there now exactly one canonical dependency model?
Is the compatibility boundary narrow enough that later work can trust the model?
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a gate-A corrective subbundle from `subbundles/_corrective-foundation-stabilization` or `subbundles/_corrective-template`, block the queue, and rerun gate A after the correction lands.
